name: fold-runtime
description: Fold Runtime — Local Context Agent for macOS

scripts.dev: dotenv -c -- node scripts/ensure-better-sqlite3.mjs electron && dotenv -c -- turbo dev --concurrency 12 --filter=!@fold/site
scripts.desktop:dev: dotenv -c -- pnpm --filter @fold/desktop rebuild:native && dotenv -c -- pnpm --parallel --filter @fold/asr-proxy --filter @fold/desktop dev
scripts.e2e:smoke: dotenv -c -- node scripts/ensure-better-sqlite3.mjs node && dotenv -c -- bash scripts/e2e-smoke.sh
scripts.test:agent-stress: dotenv -c -- node scripts/ensure-better-sqlite3.mjs node && dotenv -c -- tsx scripts/agent-stress/run.ts
scripts.recipe:stats: dotenv -c -- node scripts/ensure-better-sqlite3.mjs node && dotenv -c -- tsx scripts/recipe-stats.ts
